newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Gaming unit may pay WMS fee.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Gaming unit may pay WMS fee.

text.p: Alliance Gaming Corp said on Tuesday New York State's Supreme Court had entered a judgment requiring its unit, Bally Gaming, to pay WMS Industries Inc $4.8 million and associated interest and costs.
Alliance said it was reviewing the court's decision and considering its legal alternatives, which could include an appeal.
The lawsuit arose out of a dispute concerning a break-up fee allegedly due under a proposed merger agreement between WMS and Bally Gaming, Alliance said.
After WMS and Bally Gaming's merger agreement was terminated, Bally Gaming was subsequently acquired by Alliance, the company said.
Alliance said the payment, if it was required to make it, would not have a materially adverse impact on its financial position or operations.
